text: 华夏基金公告称，基于对中国资本市场长期健康稳定发展的信心，公司将于2026年10月23日运用固有资金2亿元认购华夏质量甄选主动管理交易型开放式股票证券投资基金（基金代码：581030，场内简称：质量主动，扩位证券简称：质量主动ETF华夏）。
text_en: China AMC announced that, based on confidence in the long-term healthy and stable development of China's capital market, the company will on October 23, 2026 use RMB 200 million of its own funds to subscribe for the China AMC Quality Selection actively managed exchange-traded open-end equity securities investment fund (fund code: 581030, exchange short name: Quality Active, expanded securities short name: Quality Active ETF China AMC).
